scripts.db:push: bash -c 'set -a; source apps/backend/.env; set +a; psql "$DATABASE_URL" -f db/schema.sql'
scripts.db:seed: bash -c 'set -a; source apps/backend/.env; set +a; psql "$DATABASE_URL" -f db/seed.sql'
scripts.db:migrate: bash -c 'set -a; source apps/backend/.env; set +a; node-pg-migrate up -m db/migrations'
scripts.db:migrate:down: bash -c 'set -a; source apps/backend/.env; set +a; node-pg-migrate down -m db/migrations'
